denominators.note: Groups are formed only among providers with an accepted ABN in this run's priority subset; providers not yet looked up cannot appear in a group.

stage_b_run.subset_rule: joined to an enforcement action, or service_count >= 5, or state_count > 1

caveats: Parent and subsidiary relationships are NOT derivable from free ABR data: they need paid ASIC extracts and are out of scope. A group here is one legal entity (one ABN or ACN) holding several provider approvals, nothing more.
A business-name overlap flag is a lead, not a finding: a shared brand or trading name is not evidence of common ownership.

total_services is the sum of current ACECQA service counts of the group's provider approvals. actions_last_24_months counts published enforcement actions of every type in the window (not breaches), only from registers collected so far. Absence of an action is not evidence of safety.
ABNs come from a name match on ABN Lookup and are not verified by hand. Verify any ABN on ABN Lookup before it is shown publicly. ACECQA content is not openly licensed: internal use only.
